intent: Read ECOSTRESS spectrum files into the spectral library, where they are matched against reflectance images.

base.docs/spectrum-format.md:
# ECOSTRESS spectrum files

A header of "Key: value" lines, then one wavelength and value pair per line:

    Name: Basalt H-1
    Type: Rock
    Measurement: Directional (10 Degree) Hemispherical Reflectance
    X Units: Wavelength (micrometers)
    Y Units: Reflectance (percent)

Mineral files may instead be measured in transmission, with Y Units such as "Transmittance (percent)".
